## Area Court

### Area Courts can hear some traffic cases.

### Locations & Times

Monday 6:00 pm – Courtroom B: Hamilton County Justice Center: 1000 Sycamore St., Cincinnati, OH 45202

Wednesday 6:00 pm – Courtroom B: Hamilton County Justice Center: 1000 Sycamore St., Cincinnati, OH 45202

### Questions?

Call the Clerk of Court’s office at (513) 946-6041

## Traffic Arraignment Rooms

### Locations

Hamilton County Courthouse: 1000 Main St., Cincinnati, OH 45202

Courtrooms A or B - Hamilton County Justice Center: 1000 Sycamore St., Cincinnati, OH 45202

## OVI

Initial appearances for cases of Operating a Vehicle while Intoxicated (OVI) (if cited to court or bond is made) will be in Courthouse Room 121

If the defendant is incarcerated, the initial appearance of an OVI case will be in Courtroom A - Hamilton County Justice Center: 1000 Sycamore St., Cincinnati, OH 45202
